question: When the LORD invited Ahaz to ask for a sign, how did Ahaz reply?
options: He asked for fire from heaven
He asked for the sun to go back
He said he would not ask, and would not put the LORD to the test
explanation: In Isaiah 7:12 Ahaz said, 'I will not ask; I will not put the LORD to the test,' even though God had told him to ask.
